WAR_NPC_DESC_13A_COLD: I pause, considering the offer. All I hear is the soft, muted howl of the frozen wind outside.0.4 Is this a trap? A test? The warrior indicates a willingness to trade...
WAR_NPC_DESC_13A_HOT: I pause, considering the offer. My skin pricks, suddenly sweating, a reminder of the constant heat just beyond the facility's walls. 0.4 Is this a trap? A test? The warrior indicates a willingness to trade...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_13: The warrior shakes their head, disappointed. Units are, presumably, traceable by the authorities.0.4 I go to make another offer, but they appear to have decided I am too much of a risk. %NAME% closes the vault.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_13: The shifty lifeform nods. A deal is done. With a soft, low growl and the briefest flap of their jaws, %NAME% reaches into their pile of contraband. They hand over an upgrade module for my starship.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_13:
The warrior glares. They reach for their own Multi-Tool. All too suddenly, I remember that the security cameras have been disabled.
After a tense moment,Sad %NAME% stuffs units into my hands. They wish to buy my silence.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14: The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Military orders for an upcoming operation fill their terminal screen. When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_DUST:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head out into the desert and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_LUSH:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head into the forest and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_TOX:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head out into the toxic wasteland and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_RAD:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to brave the planet's radiation storms and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_COLD:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head out into the frozen wastes and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
WAR_NPC_DESC_14_HOT:
The warrior is young, and looks terrified. Their terminal screen is full of orders, instructing them to head outside into the heat and join a military campaign against Sentinels.
When they see me their eyes widen. They proffer their Multi-Tool towards me with trembling hands.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_14: New recruit abandon post! Desert Vy'keen High Command orders! Take Multi-Tool weapon!
WAR_NPC_DESC_14A: Their yelps sound pleading. The fear in their movements are more than apparent. They are so on edge that they doesn't seem aware of the security cameras that surround us, watching our every move.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_14: The young conscript makes preparations to abandon their post. Silent cameras record their act of disobedience. My part in their desertion has been noted by the Vy'keen authorities.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_14: I refuse, and try my best to give the the young warrior a stirring bark. They looked cheered by this effort - or perhaps shamed by the comparison - and take back their weapon. They will die in glorious battle.
WAR_NPC_DESC_15: The lifeform clicks their heels together in an authoritarian fashion. They display a series of holographic images - a reptilian figure, and a taller lifeform in a metal casing - before gesturing aggressively with their weapon.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_15: Interloper! Give Vy'keen interrogator enemy information! Sacrifice enemy friendship, receive Vy'keen reward!
WAR_NPC_DESC_15A: The warrior snarls at me, and their fingers twitch over the weapon's trigger. They demand an answer...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_15: I tell the lifeform all I know of the Gek and the Korvax, but it is hard to convey anything meaningful with only gestures. Eventually, %NAME% sighs and motions for me to leave.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_15: I try to tell the warrior that I have no information to give them. They become angry. I protest further, but this only induces them to strike me with their weapon.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_15:
I stand tall and bark at the warrior as fiercely as I can, attempting to resemble a Vy'keen of high rank. %NAME% looks astonished.
Conditioned by years of obedience, they become cowed, apologetic. They hand over their own Multi-Tool as tribute.
WAR_NPC_DESC_16: The warrior is old, and of a high rank. They take their time studying my body and my equipment – and snarl with disapproval.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_16: Pathetic interloper species! Equivalent to Korvax and Gek! Show Vy'keen warrior strength!
WAR_NPC_DESC_16A: I flinch slightly, an involuntary reaction to their spittle-flecked barks. The elderly Vy'keen rolls their eyes, their disdain palpable. I think of ways to impress them...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_16: I attempt a small dance. The elderly warrior is stunned.Negative They WPN_PL_MELEEstrike me, with great force.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_16: The elderly warrior laughs, amused by my boldness. They pause for a moment, then hand me a component taken from their personal Multi-Tool.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_16: The elderly warriors snorts with derision. They push me away. I have not earned the right to bow to them.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_DUST:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, tasting the desert air that has followed me in to this once sterile facility.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_LUSH:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, tasting the humid air that has followed me in to this once sterile facility.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_TOX:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, sampling the damp, caustic smell of the toxic rain that lingers on my Exosuit.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_RAD:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, tasting the metallic tang of the radiation that lingers on my Exosuit.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_COLD:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, filling their lungs with the frozen air that has followed me into the sanctuary of this facility.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_17_HOT:
The warrior's nostrils flare as I approach. They inhale deeply, filling their lungs with the burning air that has followed me in to the relative cool of the facility.
They bark out what could be a warning. I hurriedly mime that I am peaceful, and know little of their kind or language.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_17: Pathetic interloper! Give elements! Carbon preferred! Honourable warrior teach language!
WAR_NPC_DESC_17A: They take a second to think, then grab my Multi-Tool while barking again into my visor – streaking it with saliva. They point at the Mining Beam charge indicator, then at my backpack. I do my best to keep calm.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_17: The warrior grunts, a little surprised. It seems we have misunderstood one another. They teach me some of the language of their people in an attempt to bridge this divide.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_17: The warrior grunts in satisfaction. Impressed by both my gift and my understanding, they teach me several new words of their language.
WAR_NPC_DESC_18: As I approach, the warrior appears alert and welcoming. Suddenly, however, a personal alarm sounds from their datapad. The lifeform instinctively falls into some kind of trance.Sad Their eyes mist over, they stare straight through me and begin to mumble a repetitious mumble.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_18: Hirk blesses the sleep. Hirk recharges the warrior. Cursed is the warrior that interrupts the sleep of Hirk.
WAR_NPC_DESC_18A: I notice a collection of freshly-assembled upgrade modules scattered around the entranced warrior...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_18: I touch the warrior on the shoulder. They jolt, awakening from their trance. They scream with rage, furious to have been interrupted. I back away rapidly.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_18: I wait while %NAME% completes their ritual.0.6 Eventually, they reawaken. PositiveThe final part of the rite must be gift-giving, for their shower me with tribute.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_18: Slowly, I reach forward and collect an upgrade module. Moments later, the warrior awakes from their trance. They notice their missing belongings and rage at me. I leave, quickly.
WAR_NPC_DESC_19: The downbeat lifeform is studying the image of another young warrior on their pad. The pictured warrior looks virile and impressive. They have facial tendrils that are outstretched. They appear rich, and of good breeding stock. The look in their eyes is... sultry.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_19: Grah! Warrior accept mating proposition? Accept dowry tribute?
WAR_NPC_DESC_19A: The lifeform looks to me with questioning eyes. They clearly need someone to talk this through with.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_19: The young warrior nods. They relay a message of acceptance. Speakers throughout the facility play orchestral music. The lifeform shares some of the dowry they receive.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_19: An elder appears on-screen and curses us. Their cruelty and bile is evident even as a hologram. %NAME% looks at me, thankful to have avoided this fate. Discreetly, they hand me the gift they had prepared for their new clan.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_19: I take the pad and attempt to send a message on behalf of the nervous warrior, but there appears to be some sort of misunderstanding by the recipient. I receive generous gifts, and a candid image of the lifeform I will one day wed.
WAR_NPC_DESC_20: The warrior is listening to angry message on their datapad. It's a sequence of furious barks and screams that clearly have a moral high ground. The lifeform notices me and yelps pitifully.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_20: Grah! Duel challenge must be fought! Accuser is large, powerful! Vy'keen is doomed! Death! Death!
WAR_NPC_DESC_20A: The datapad screen has switched to display a threatening diagram, in which the warrior appears to be missing several vital parts of their anatomy. They turn to me, imploring.
WAR_NPC_RES_A_20: The warrior inhales the battle gas. They seem refreshed and revived, eager where they had been afraid. They roar in anticipation of the fight ahead, then thank me with a generous gift.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_20:
As the warrior takes the dagger, their nervousness seems to leave them. They let it settle in their grip, assessing its weight. Satisfied, a grimace spreads across their face.
%NAME% hands me their Multi-Tool. They have no more need of it.
WAR_NPC_RES_C_20: %NAME% looks shocked. They had been frightened, but had never considered cowardice. They shake their head at me, offended.
WAR_NPC_DESC_21: The warrior is building some sort of bomb. The plans they hold in their hand are unmistakable. A complicated sequence of blueprints and isotopic chemical reactions is waiting for the final addition of an element to be complete.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_21: Grah! Vy'keen war preparation nears completion! Death to the unsuspecting Gek! Give explosion element!
WAR_NPC_DESC_21A: %NAME% appears to be asking me for help in completing their weapon...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_21: I hand the warrior a substantial deposit of uranium. They stare, wide-eyed, then let forth a roar of delight. They thank me with gifts of their own, and excitedly get to work. I fear for what I may have unleashed...
WAR_NPC_RES_B_21: I hand the warrior a packet of explosives. They take it, shifting it from hand to hand, assessing it. Pleased, they thump me on the chest appreciatively. They thank me by way of an upgrade module, and begin plotting their targets...
WAR_NPC_RES_C_21: The warrior snarls. They do not need me, and have no interest in my objections. They will not let my anything disrupt their mission...
WAR_NPC_DESC_22: The storage vault at the warrior's feet shows clear signs of tampering. In fact, an explosive device has been attached to its hinges. The lifeform sees my shocked expression, and yaps in amusement.
DNT_WAR_NPC_LANG_22: Grah! Pathetic distant warrior leave powerful Multi-Tool in storage vault! Avoid processed element usage in explosion - too powerful! Raw element required!
WAR_NPC_DESC_22A: The bomb needs fuel for ignition, which would most likely blow the vault wide open. The warrior impatiently tries to explain what should happen next...
WAR_NPC_RES_A_22: The lock on the vault is blown clear off. I retrieve a Multi-Tool upgrade that lies within.
WAR_NPC_RES_B_22: Shrapnel embeds itself in my knees and ankles. The pain is extreme.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_1: The lifeform presents me with a new technology
ALL_NPC_REWARD_2: The warrior gives me a technology blueprint, and teaches me some of the language of their people.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_3: The lifeform presents me with a gift.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_4: The lifeform presents me with units.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_5: The lifeform presents me with an alloy.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_6: The lifeform offers me a new Multi-Tool.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_7: The lifeform gives me a new formula.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_8: The lifeform teaches me some of the language of their people.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_9: The lifeform gives me a strange curio.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_11: I am offered a new Multi-Tool.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_13: I receive a new product formula.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_19: I receive a strange alien delicacy.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_21: I receive a strange alien curiosity.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_22: I receive knowledge of an alien language.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_23: I receive the coordinates of a useful location.
ALL_NPC_REWARD_24: I receive a security access pass.
ALL_FAC_REWARD_DESC: Normal operations have resumed, and I have access to the facility's main control panel. I should be able to alter production to my own benefit.
ALL_FAC_REWARD_DESC_SHORT: Normal operations have resumed, and I have access to the facility's main control panel.
TRA_FAC_DESC_1: I approach the terminal, but something deep within the complex is malfunctioning. Surfaces feel hot to the touch, hidden machinery clanks and whirrs. An alert sounds:
TRA_FAC_DESC_1A: The alarm rings in my ears. A bead of sweat rolls slowly down my forehead.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_1: Warning! High temperature! Warning! High temperature!
TRA_FAC_RES_A_1: Numbers on the terminal display begin to stabilise, red flashing symbols morphing into a calming blue array of light.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_1: CrystalAltar_CollectActivating the fusion dampening causes a power surge. The terminal shorts and cuts out. The system no longer responds to my commands.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_1: CrystalAltar_CollectNumbers on the screen in front of me rise rapidly as I activate the laser array. I feel a dramatic surge of heat through the terminal, before the entire system shuts down.
TRA_FAC_DESC_2: The control terminal before me appears to be for some sort of deep-level mining system. However, all systems have stalled. The screen flashes a readout:
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_2: Mining production stalled! Low power! Low fuel! Organic matter required!
TRA_FAC_DESC_2A: Warning lights blink on and off. A material hopper opens.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_2: Lights flicker across the facility. Machinery rumbles deep beneath my feet as the drill motor whirrs into life. The facility is back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_2: The ferrite slips down the material hopper, but the choking, grinding sound that follows does not sound positive.0.4 The machinery shuts down completely.0.5I fear I have flooded important internal components with metallic dust.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_2: Metallic gears grab at my fingers. Sparks fly from my Exosuit gloves, shorting the terminal. I pull my hand back sharply as the hopper slams shut.
TRA_FAC_DESC_3:
The outpost has gone into emergency lockdown. Something must have been damaged during my entry.
The toxicity gauge on my Exosuit flickers as an alert flashes insistently on the control terminal.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_3: High gas pressure! Breach detected! Pressure critical!
TRA_FAC_DESC_3A: The alarms on the panel flash rapidly, demanding attention. A bewildering array of control gauges sit before me.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_3: A low rumble passes underneath my feet as I activate the emergency vent. Slowly but surely the indicators on the panel start to stabilise and the warning lights soften.0.4 The facility comes back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_3: Pipes under the floor gurgle and hiss as I twist the coolant valve. A sudden burst of steam erupts from the panel, destroying the instruments.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_3: The alarms blink with increased intensity.0.5A pipe ruptures, venting toxic gas directly into the facility!
TRA_FAC_DESC_5: Strange symbols pulse urgently on the terminal display. The flashing lights and loud siren appear to relate to the facility's nuclear power core. A message prints out on the display.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_5: Fusion critical! Initiate emergency radiation dampening measures!
TRA_FAC_DESC_5A: The automated safety systems have failed. Something must have been damaged as I entered the facility.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_5: The wail of the alarm system fades and the temperature readings slowly decay back to normal levels. Disaster has been averted, and the facility's production line returns to normal.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_5: Activating the emergency shudown procedure calms the wail of the sirens. Lights on the terminal flicker and die,  and the facility's machinery has fallen silent, but at least nothing has exploded.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_5:
While I panic, the facility's fusion core overwhelms its dampening system and goes into meltdown.
A backup system prevents the total destruction of the facility, but the terminal is critically damaged.
TRA_FAC_RES_D_5:
As I turn to leave, the facility's fusion core overwhelms its dampening system and goes into meltdown.
A backup system prevents the total destruction of the facility, but the terminal is critically damaged.
TRA_FAC_DESC_6: The facility remains operational despite my intrusion. This terminal appears to control the central production line. A readout on the display displays a status warning:
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_6: Warning! Increase metal delivery! Warning! Excess usage creates breach!
TRA_FAC_DESC_6A: A large dial features prominently under the readout. It appears to control the system's material inputs.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_6: The system struggles on, producing a small number of components. Gradually the hoppers empty, and production grinds to a halt.0.4 The terminal shuts down, unpowered.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_6: The warnings cease, and the system maintains its production. The increased pressure has kept the fabricators whirring and the facility at full power.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_6: I hear hydraulic systems activate as hoppers open all over the facility, flooding the fabricators with raw material. Gears grind and pipes strain against the sudden abundance. With a loud crash, the system overloads. 0.4 Production comes to a total halt.
TRA_FAC_DESC_7: The alarms blares, and the terminal in front of me is scrambled. Through the flickering of the corrupted display I can just about make out a message:
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_7: Warning! Magnetic coil overcharged! Production low!
TRA_FAC_DESC_7A: I feel heavy. My Multi-Tool pulls me down, and my helmet forces itself into my shoulders. It's not just me impacted. Production processes are going haywire...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_7:
I feel a strange sensation deep within my brain as gravity momentarily destabilises. The electromagnetic stablisers in my Exosuit prevent any more dramatic effects.
However, power has not been restored to the terminal. If anything, it has only suffered more damage. The facility remains inoperable.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_7: A slow shiver pulses through my body as the powerful electromagnetic wave sweeps across the facility.0.4 Almost immediately, the terminal screen clears up. The production facility is back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_7:
I throw the master power switch that sits alongside the terminal. The facility powers down. I reset the switch, and hope...
It does not power back up again.
TRA_FAC_DESC_9: The wail of an alarm fills my ears, but the system is not reacting to my intrusion. Someone else has been here and modified this terminal before. I struggle to decipher the data on the terminal.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_9: Warning! Unexpected system detected! Bypass chip template detected! Gek Trade Federation informed!
TRA_FAC_DESC_9A: Whatever code has been loaded on the terminal is clearly the work of some enterprising thief. It appears to be emptying the resource vaults of rare metals.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_9: I reset the system back to its default production loadout. Things appear to be operating as expected.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_9: I attempt to perform my own hijack of the terminal. It reroutes some of the automated profit flows directly to my account. However, my intrusion is clearly not subtle enough. Anti-tampering systems react and lock me out of the terminal.
TRA_FAC_DESC_11: Despite the warnings sounding out across the facility, the terminal remains open and ready for commerce. A brief introductory message blinks on the screen.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_11: Friend! Know language, know commerce! Units buy knowledge! Choose Vy'keen, choose Korvax or choose a refresher in the language of the benevolent Gek!
TRA_FAC_DESC_11A: Three columns of words endlessly scroll on-screen, each in a strange alphabet. Bloodied runes scratched in sand, a precise sequences of dots, and a hand-written font full of exclamatory punctuation.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_11: As I scan the runes, I feel a deep-seated roar rattle around my mind. A word sears itself into my brain, the language of a distant warrior race.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_11: The dots race across the screen, an elegant, dancing pattern. I settle into the rhythm, and suddenly feel a burst of comprehension.0.4A word sears itself into my brain. I feel altered by the process.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_11: I feel a chittering glee as I scan the words the terminal presents. My other senses are affected, and I feel almost as if I could smell the language. Suddenly, a word sears itself into my brain, a fragment of Gek speech.
TRA_FAC_DESC_12: Alarms echo across the facility, a warning against my intrusion. Such an alert does not appear to slow down the commercial needs of the Gek, however. A nearby trade-ship is hailing the facility, looking for goods.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_12: Gek Trade Federation dispatch! Planetary metal demand high! Collection ship imminent!
TRA_FAC_DESC_12A: Perhaps if I were to offer goods of my own, I might both turn a profit and avoid alerting the Gek that there is an intruder in their facility...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_12: A relieved beaked trader shouts their thanks through the speaker systems. The success of the transaction appears to convince the security systems that I am a legitimate user.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_12: The terminal shuts down rapidly. I can only assume my reply gave me away, and the trader alerted the authorities to my intrusion.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_12:
The trade vault slams shut.

I only receive a small payment.
TRA_FAC_DESC_13: My dramatic entry appears to have caused a fire alert. The screen is wet to the touch. A warning flashes on the terminal:
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_13: Warning! Resource vault flooded! Production system operation forbidden!
TRA_FAC_DESC_13A: Panels in the ceiling drip where a sprinkler system has been engaged. I can only hope the liquid is water.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_13: The system sputters a little, showing signs of life. But it is not to be - a shower of sparks reveals a short-circuit within the flooded terminal. It closes down, the facility lifeless.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_13:
The drained resource vault feeds rare elements into the production system.

The facility is back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_13: Despite a dramatic gurgling from beneath my feet, the facility remains offline. The terminal, fatally damaged, shorts out.
TRA_FAC_DESC_14: I open the terminal, looking for a way to shut off the alarm. Primary access appears to be via some sort of hand scanner.
TRA_FAC_DESC_14A:
I place my Exosuit glove upon the indent.
Without warning, a thousand tiny needles shoot out of the reader, meshing my hand to the machine. A synthetic voice speaks to me.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_14: Friend healing and repair station initializing! Please, be happy!
TRA_FAC_RES_A_14: I grab my Multi-Tool with my free hand and fire at the terminal.0.4 It explodes, releasing its grip. A few shards of metal remain embedded in my fingers, but I am free.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_14: I struggled against the grip of the machine. As I pull, my hand rips free. The terminal is covered in blood.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_14:
A beautiful, clean feeling overcomes me. The terminal pumps some sort of healing fluid into my Exosuit. I feel utterly refreshed.
The process completes, and the facility accepts me as one if its own.
TRA_FAC_DESC_15: The alarm has rebooted the facility. An automated start-up routine is running. The terminal flashes text at me, clearly expecting some input.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_15: Warning! Product recipe unselected! Assign recipe! Gek Trade Federation lose units!
TRA_FAC_DESC_15A: A 3D interface waits in front of me, awaiting a blueprint for the facility to mass-produce. Machines around me hum as they warm up...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_15: The terminal accepts my design and the installation start-up procedure completes. I hope the Gek who run this facility are happy with my choice.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_15: The terminal accepts my design and the installation start-up procedure completes. The Gek who run this facility may appreciate the extra green in their environment.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_15: The terminal accepts my design and the installation start-up procedure completes. I hope the Gek who run this facility are happy with their vast pile of sugar.
TRA_FAC_DESC_16: The facility's machinery lies still, halted by the emergency shutdown. A short message blinks on the control terminal.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_16: User warning! Production disengaged. Restart generator empty. No fuel. Facility restart requires organic fuel.
TRA_FAC_DESC_16A: A heavy circuit control switch sits invitingly above a fuel hopper, but a nearby dial shows that the tank is empty.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_16:
I feed the fuel tank with a catalyst, hoping to boost the effect of whatever material powers this facility.
I throw the switch. 0.66 A low rumble is followed by a loud explosion deep within the facility. The terminal immediately cuts out.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_16:
I feed a large amount of ferrite dust into the system's fuel supply. The pipes become sticky and choked, the dust mixing with the residue of other fuels.
I throw the switch, but to no avail. The generator system splurts and coughs before shutting down completely.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_16:
The carbon-based fuel slips down the hopper's metal throat. I hear a gurgle as it feeds into the generator system.
I throw the switch. 0.8 The generator ticks over, then roars into life. The surge of power from the generator triggers the facility's main reactor, and the machinery comes back online.
TRA_FAC_DESC_22: An unknown fault has forced the whole system offline. There is a strange chill in the air, a sharp clarity to the atmosphere.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_22: Alert! Alert! Liquid frenium leak! Charge cylinders frozen! Increase temperature!
TRA_FAC_DESC_22A: I exhale as I ponder the words on the terminal. Condensation begins to cloud my visor.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_22: Warmth spreads through the facility. The air around me remains strange to look at, but the production systems return online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_22: The system remains frozen. If anything, the air around me becomes even icier. Strange crystals frost over the surface of the terminal as it shuts down.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_22: The noise of muffled explosions can be heard beneath my feet. The facility does become rapidly warmer, but all systems shut down dramatically.
TRA_FAC_DESC_23: Emergency measures have been initialised. The timestamp on the terminal's error reporting display shows that the incident occured long before my intrusion.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_23: Electrolyte acidity test positive! Acidity slug detected! Release alkaline neutrality fluid into solution tank!
TRA_FAC_DESC_23A: A recent scan shows a small alien lifeform crushed in the machinery below. Equipment all round it has corroded.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_23:
There is a hiss as the alkaline solution floods the facility's pipes. Machinery strains, trying to break free of the blockage in the gears.
With an unsettling snap, the production facility comes back online. The remains of the lifeform must have been washed free of the mechanisms.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_23: The air takes on a curious acidic tang. Fragile wires in the terminal corrode rapidly. The display shorts out, and then shuts down entirely.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_23: A frenzied chemical reaction can be heard somewhere beneath my feet. The terminal - and the rest of the facility - shuts down entirely.
TRA_FAC_DESC_24: The terminal barks a repeated warning. Though the words are unclear, the symbol is instantly recognisable. Something, somewhere in the facility is on fire.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_24: Resource vault fire detected! Element stockpile destroyed!
TRA_FAC_DESC_24A: A faint smoke begins to rise, and my scanner registers a steadily increasing temperature.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_24:
I hear a hiss as the air drains from the machinery chambers beneath my feet. The heat levels remain steady, however.
The control terminal enters an automated shutdown.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_24:
I hear a hiss as the air drains from the resource vaults beneath my feet. Slowly but surely the heat levels start to drop. The fire is under control.
Enough remains in the vault that I should be able to restore the facility to operational status.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_24: The facility sprinkler showers above my head. It has no impact on the internal fire, but does short out the control terminal.
TRA_FAC_DESC_25: My entry has caused the facility to go into immediate lockdown, interrupting its operation. Visual readouts on the terminal indicate that this is a deep-level mining facility. Its resource vaults are emptying rapidly.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_25: Drilling error! Elements drain into planet core! Reverse tunnel pressure!
TRA_FAC_DESC_25A: The facility map shows flashing errors over both the resource collection vaults and the drill array...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_25: I hear a deep, distant noise, a subterranean roll of thunder. The resource vaults empty entirely, drained into the earth. The facility remains offline.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_25: The drilling rig retracts from the shaft, but this only seems to accelerate the loss of material. The dials spin furiously before settling. The resource vaults are empty, drained into the earth. The facility remains offline.
TRA_FAC_RES_C_25: I hear a deep, distant noise, a subterranean roll of thunder. Slowly the resource vaults beneath the surface stop spilling their contents into the earth, and eventually begin to refill. The facility comes back online.
EXP_FAC_DESC_1: My unauthorised intrusion has activated an alert on the control terminal. Its lights flash an angry, hostile red.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_1: Reboot initialised. Data loss probability warning. Offsite back-up detonation initialised.
EXP_FAC_DESC_1A: Security countermeasures have begun a full system wipe. I see file after file being purged from the records.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_1: I forcibly restart the system.0.8. After a short delay, the screen comes back to life. All trace of the security programme has vanished.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_1: My attempt to meddle is detected immediately. The system reboots to a blank screen. All data has been lost.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_1: As I wait, the countermeasures complete their purge of the system. The terminal shuts down, its screen a lifeless black.
EXP_FAC_DESC_3: My entry into the facility has interrupted an automated maintenance routine. The terminal flashes a warning message:
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_3: Save failed! Tech blueprint data corrupted! Reconstruction probability: high
EXP_FAC_DESC_3A: A fragmented file appears to have frozen the system. The machine is stuck in a loop trying to access it.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_3: The data recovery operation completes successfully. One by one the errors clear from the terminal screen.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_3: Manually deleting the corrupted file appears to free the machine from its degenerate loop. I can only hope it contained nothing valuable.
EXP_FAC_DESC_4: The facility rings with the blare of an alarm. However, it appears I am not the first intruder. The terminal display indicates a previous hijack attempt.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_4: Virus detection warning! File extracting valuable data!
EXP_FAC_DESC_4A: Strange, shifting glyphs dance across the terminals command prompt. Some alien code is taking over the system's research drive.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_4: The quarantine operation is succesful and the alien code is purged from the system. The alarms fall silent.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_4:
I tap out a few commands, acknowleding but not removing the virus.
There is a short, almost deliberate delay. Runes shift across the display.0.6 The terminal grants me root access to the facility. The alien code resumes its harvesting operation.
EXP_FAC_DESC_5: The outpost appears to have been in the middle of complex planetary scan. Alarms sound against my intrusion, but the operation continues. I attempt to make sense of the output.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_5: Warning! Interruption forbidden! Sentinel scan ending soon! Control returning to overseer imminently!
EXP_FAC_DESC_5A: The scan continues. It seems to be consuming all the facility's resources, preventing other operations. A large red override button blinks temptingly.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_5: I hit the override button. The scan data is deleted.0.8 A remote process, detecting the premature end of the scan, shuts down the entire facility.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_5: I wait, patient. The scan finishes processing and uploads its data. With this special task complete, the facility comes back online.
EXP_FAC_DESC_7: My entry has caused the facility to go into immediate lockdown, interrupting its operation. Readouts on the terminal indicate some sort of deep-level exploratory or drilling operation.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_7: Geological scan in progress! Medial strata mined. Remote connection error! Immediate probe recall required!
EXP_FAC_DESC_7A: A probe schematic flashes red. Some input appears to be required.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_7:
I hear the whirr of gears and the hissing of metal cable. The facility shudders slightly as the machinery bites into the cable and begins to pull.
After an agonising delay, the terminal reports a successful extraction. The alarms cease.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_7: I try several times to restart the probe. It fails to respond to my commands. Meanwhile, the malfunction alerts grow ever harsher.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_7: I hear a deep, distant noise, a subterranean roll of thunder. Alerts and alarms fill the terminal screen, most of them flashing angrily. The terminal refuses to accept further input.
EXP_FAC_DESC_8:
Alarms blare, sounding out against my intrusion. The facility is remotely operated, and no-one responds to the klaxon's call.
The terminal indicates the facility was undertaking a specialised piece of research.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_8: Experiment containment failure. Common fuel element overcharge explosion. Clarify should continue?
EXP_FAC_DESC_8A: The terminal appears to be asking for manual confirmation of its experiment...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_8:
I tap a few commands into the terminal, authorising it to continue.
There is a pause, then a rumble.0.6 Fire belches from the hopper. Smoke seeps from the terminal keyboard. The entire system shuts down.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_8:
I tap a few commands into the terminal, bringing it to an end. A small amount of ash is ejected from a nearby hopper.
The machinery hums as it reconfigures itself for standard research operations.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_8:
I tap a few commands into the terminal, opening its input hopper. I insert some carbon from Exosuit.
There is a pause, then a rumble.0.6 Fire belches from the hopper. Smoke seeps from the terminal keyboard. The entire system shuts down.
EXP_FAC_DESC_13: Machinery here is mining a captured asteroid for oxides. The process has stalled. The facility reeks of burnt metal, and the floor is hot to touch. I search the terminal for clues.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_13: Eheu, drill motor automated disconnection! Motor fire! Repair immediately Entity!
EXP_FAC_DESC_13A: The terminal presents a number of repair drone options. 0.2 Beneath my feet I hear the ominous creaking and popping of metal straining against itself.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_13:
The asteroid mining drill bit is replaced.

It remains non-operational.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_13:
The facility deploys a swarm of nano-drones deep within its inner workings. The terminal tracks their progress towards the repair site.
Countless drones perish in the fire, but they eventually get on top of heat levels in the malfunctioning drill motor.0.4. Slowly but surely, the facility comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_13:
The facility deploys a swarm of nano-drones deep within its inner workings. The terminal tracks their progress towards the repair site.
One by one the drones vanish from the tracker. Smoke begins to seep from the terminal controls, before the panel shuts down completely.
EXP_FAC_DESC_10: Security systems have reacted to my unauthorised entry. The terminal barks a series of warnings.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_10: Illegal access! Security control deployed! All goods will be incinerated!
EXP_FAC_DESC_10A: The terminal cycles images of flames. I can feel the heat rising from the resource vaults below.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_10: The flames in the resource vault subside. The facility has lost some of its supplies, but is otherwise undamaged.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_10:
The element stokes the flames.

The experiment takes place, producing valuable trade goods.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_10: I add oxygen to the fire raging in the vaults below. The intensity increases and smoke floods from the resource hoppers. The terminal shuts down, and my suit begins to overheat. I have only myself to blame.
EXP_FAC_DESC_15: My intrusion has triggered some sort of scrambled shutdown. Even over the sound of the alarm, I can hear the rumble of elements cascading away through the pipes. The terminal blinks a warning:
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_15: Warning! Catalyst overload! Circuit board technology overheat warning!
EXP_FAC_DESC_15A: It seems that the system is struggling to cope with the overflow. An automated emergency stop is about to be issued.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_15: The noise of cascading elements subsides. The alarms cease.0.4 However, so does the facility's operation.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_15: Overriding the security alert immediately stops the alarm. With no reason to prolong the shutdown process, the facility's AI reverses the element cascade and returns system to normal.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_15: I activate the facility's coolant injectors. The cascade continues, but the warnings become less severe. Eventually, they stop. The problem has been brought under control, though the facility is substantially less wealthy.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_DUSTY: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed choking atmospheric dust to clog sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is shorting out beneath my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_LUSH: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed some sort of metal-eating bacteria to breach sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is corroding at my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_TOX: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed atmospheric toxins to breach sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is corroding at my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_RAD: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed atmospheric radiation to breach sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is decaying at my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_HOT: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed the overwhelming atmospheric heat to overwhelm sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is failing beneath my finger-tips.
EXP_FAC_DESC_16_COLD: The air is compromised. My entry has allowed the fearsome external chill to overwhelm sensitive systems. Even the primary terminal is failing beneath my finger-tips.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_16: Alert! Alert! Power core isolated! Central artificial intelligence core endangered! Hostile environment detected!
EXP_FAC_DESC_16A: A number of recovery operations are available...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_16: I safeguard the power core against the breach. However, vital control systems appear to have been damaged beyond repair.0.4 I listen to the hum of the powerplant, the only sound audible in the now inoperable facility.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_16: I seal off the facility's primary motherboard. However, vital control systems appear to have been damaged beyond repair.0.4 The entirely facility starts to shut down.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_16: I safeguard the control units that house the facility's primary AI.0.4 With the computer running the facility, the appropriate countermeasures are soon deployed and the hostile environment purged.
EXP_FAC_DESC_18: Operations are offline. A recent research scan has been corrupted, likely by my unexpected interruption. It is crashing every system in the outpost.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_18: Bad data. Sentinel drone activity scan corrupted. System disengaged.
EXP_FAC_DESC_18A: The terminal scrolls through a list of potentially corrupt files. I appear to have deletion rights...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_18: I delete a number of files related to the quadrupeds that guard the facility, but the system remains offline
EXP_FAC_RES_B_18: I delete an unusually large file, a scan the network process that controls the nearby Sentinel drones.0.5 There is a sudden, large jump in available computational resources. The installation's primary processes begin to restart.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_18: I delete a number of geological data packets, but the system remains offline
EXP_FAC_DESC_19: Wild energy fluctuations have brought research operations to a standstill. When I touch the terminal to investigate, a residual electric charge earths itself through my Exosuit.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_19: Alert! Electronic terminal operator power discharge! Reset primary interface!
EXP_FAC_DESC_19A: Readouts on the terminal indicate the power fluctuations are getting stronger and wilder. It will not be long before they bring down the entire facility.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_19: I attempt to stabilise the flow of power throughout the facility, but the fluctuations continue. The terminal begins to short out, then dramatically shuts down completely.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_19: I reset the primary interface. One by one, systems come back online. The power fluctuations cease.
EXP_FAC_DESC_20: Systems are super-charged despite the security alert. Equipment beneath my feet buzzes and whirrs with a high intensity. The terminal blinks a warning.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_20: Danger! Excess power! Decrease energy use immediately! Delivery at maximum!
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_DUSTY: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_LUSH: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_TOX: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_RAD: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_HOT: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_DESC_20A_COLD: I detect a faint smell of burning...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_20: I reduce power delivery across the board. The installation returns to acceptable activity levels.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_20: I turn up the cooling systems.0.5 The added strain on power delivery leads to a small internal fire. The terminal shuts down.
EXP_FAC_DESC_21: I approach the terminal. It flashes the expected security alert, but alongside is a warning I have not seen before.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_21: Unexpected biological blockage detected. Power delivery network disruption!
EXP_FAC_DESC_21A: A video feed shows a small creature is scrambling through the wiring below me, woken by the security alert. Its choice of nesting location was unwise...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_21: I boost power to the wiring loom.0.5 A smell of roasted meat wafts up from the systems below. The system comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_21: I send a surge of highly acidic cleaning fluid through the pipes. 0.5 The creature is swept away. I hear a faint hiss as it bubbles away to nothingness. The system comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_21: I wait. Driven by the alarms, the creature struggles desperately for the exit. Eventually, it breaks free.0.4 The system comes back online.
EXP_FAC_DESC_22: The alarm has triggered the instant incineration of the elements used here. The process they were being used for, however, is still online.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_22: Databank back-up process stalled. Raw metal required to finish process.
EXP_FAC_DESC_22A: My scanner is picking up traces of metal, leftovers from the previous production process.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_22: I feed the metal back into the facility's supply hopper. Production comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_22:
The facility takes in my element, before the resource vaults judder and spark.

The system becomes non-operational.
WAR_FAC_DESC_1: The alarm has locked the terminal. A message displays itself letter-by-letter on the screen.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_1: Suspicious interloper visual detection system initiated!
WAR_FAC_DESC_1A: The alarm shows no sign of stopping. I notice wall-mounted security scanners slowly turn towards me...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_1:
I apply a rapid burst from my Multi-Tool directly to the facility's security cameras.
This is a partial success: my image is not captured by the system, but backup sensors react to the destruction by shutting the facility down entirely.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_1: I apply an override circuit to the security relay.0.5 Remarkably, my ad-hoc wiring seems to work. The alarm stops, and the terminal grants me full access.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_1: I snap the input wires that lead from the security system to the master control terminal.0.5 Remarkably, this seems to work. The alarm stops, and the error seems to reset the terminal.
WAR_FAC_DESC_2: I approach the terminal and search for a way to override the alarm. I find a likely looking button and press it, causing the terminal to respond.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_2: Grah! Vy'keen voice security scan initializing...
WAR_FAC_DESC_2A: A flap flicks open and a microphone emerges. A distant voice shouts 'Grah!'.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_2: I bark aggressively at the terminal. This appears to satisfy whatever demand was being made of me. Access is granted.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_2: I attempt to explain, but my hesitant speech instantly marks me out as an interloper. The security system delivers a high-voltage shock to my Exosuit before shutting down the terminal.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_2: I apologise, but this display of weakness instantly marks me out as an interloper. The security system delivers a high-voltage shock to my Exosuit before shutting down the terminal.
WAR_FAC_DESC_3: I approach the terminal. As the alarm blares, a laser scan refracts through my visor, then another traces the air around my breathing exhaust. The terminal flashes a warning.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_3: Intruder detected! Respiration gas concentration high! Enemy respiration!!
WAR_FAC_DESC_3A: From what I can determine, it seems my breathing patterns may be giving me away as an interloper...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_3: I hold my breath.0.5 An age seems to pass.0.4 Finally, moments before I lose consciousness, the terminal flashes a green light. I have been accepted as a Vy'keen.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_3: I breathe as aggressively as I can, channelling my anger at the gas sensor.0.3 It has no effect. The terminal registers my failure and shuts down.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_3:
I inhale deeply before stabbing myself with the dagger.0.5. I feel so alive; shot through with adrenaline; blood pumping hard through my veins; sparks crackling down my nerves. It is glorious. Grah! Grah!
The terminal accepts me as one of the Vy'keen and allows me access.
WAR_FAC_DESC_4: The terminal flashes two alerts, presumably the source of the alarms currently ringing in my ears.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_4: Major security alert! Interloper detected! Minor alert: war factory entrance door destroyed.
WAR_FAC_DESC_4A: After printing out its status update, the terminal presents the option to override either alert. From the holographic display, the warnings appear to relate to damaged components within the facility, and the presence of an interloper.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_4: The terminal initiates an emergency shutdown.
WAR_FAC_DESC_5: I approach the terminal, searching for a way to shut off the alarm. As I stand by the input device, the floor shifts beneath my feet.0.4 I hear a click.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_5: Vy'keen security system alert! Pressure pad enemy detection confirmed! Too light! Too puny!
WAR_FAC_DESC_5A: The screen has locked itself. It appears the facility is aware I am not the lifeform that usually operates here.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_5:
I pick up a large piece of scrap metal from the floor, presumably deposited there when I blew up the door.
This has the desired effect: my weight has been increased to within the non-suspicious range for a Vy'keen warrior. The terminal grants me access.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_5: I set aside my Multi-Tool, as well as other heavy items from my Exosuit's storage. The floor scales register a further series of clicks before the security system shuts me out entirely.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_5: My rapid jumps appear to confuse whatever security device is embedded in the floor. Eventually, it either overloads or is convinced by my aggression that I am a true Vy'keen. I am granted full access to the facility.
WAR_FAC_DESC_6: My presence has triggered a security alert. I hear elements being drawn from the vaults below me. On-screen: a clear countdown.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_6: Intruder alert! Commence detonation sequence! Organic fuel flow initiated!
WAR_FAC_DESC_6A: I can hear pressurised fluids filling the pipes surrounding the terminal. The sound is rather ominous, especially when combined with the high-intensity alarms...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_6:
I clamp the fuel lines. There is a brief moment of tension as pressure builds in the pipes.
It stabilises. The countdown ends, and nothing happens.0.4 With some sort of disaster presumably averted, the terminal unlocks and grants me access.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_6: I clamp the catalyst flow.0.8 A minor explosion scorches my arm, before facility operations resume.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_6: A blast of flame coats me from below.1 The facility remains non-operational.
WAR_FAC_DESC_7: Automated security procedures are incinerating the contents of all the vaults in the facility. The terminal displays the manifest:
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_7: Intruder alert! Incinerating trading vault: imminent. Incinerating power vault: imminent. Incinerating storage vault: imminent.
WAR_FAC_DESC_7A: Power surges are igniting the vaults one-by-one. However, the terminal appears to allow for limited emergency retrievals...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_7: I activate the emergency vault retrieval system. The drone just has time to extract the contents of the trade vault before all goods are incinerated.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_7: I activate the emergency vault retrieval system. The drone just has time to extract the contents of the relic vault before all goods are incinerated.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_7: I activate the emergency vault retrieval system. The drone just has time to extract the contents of the technology vault before all goods are incinerated.
WAR_FAC_DESC_8: A transmission is firing on emergency frequencies. The terminal shows a response code from a nearby Vy'keen capital ship.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_8: Security breach! Military action unstoppable! Vy'keen High Command vessel coordinate upload imminent!
WAR_FAC_DESC_8A: It seems to be responding to my intrusion. From the images on screen, it seems to be preparing its weapon systems...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_8: I transmit the safety override code, putting an end to the emergency transmission. The Vy'keen warship stands down, broadcasting a respectful 'Grah'. The terminal unlocks.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_8: I attach a bypass circuit, allowing me to transmit the safety override code and put an end to the emergency transmission. The Vy'keen warship stands down, broadcasting a respectful 'Grah'. The terminal unlocks.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_8: I attempt to scramble the facility's coordinates, hoping to throw off the incoming fire. 0.4I hear a distant explosion and the screams of burning animals. The facility's processes return to normal.
WAR_FAC_DESC_9: As I turn on the terminal, a forward-facing security scanner clicks and whirrs into focus. My bright red image is on-screen.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_9: Interloper detection! Heat detection systems confirm report! High temperature intruder!
WAR_FAC_DESC_9A: The terminal allows me no further access. In the camera feed, blue lines cross the red of my body, matching exactly to my Exosuit's coolant mesh...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_9:
I manually override my Exosuit's coolant flow. Slowly but surely a deep chill spreads across my body. My bones ache. My blood feels like ice, stabbing against every fibre of my being.
The image on the terminal screen fades from a dramatic red to a total black. I am invisible. The security alert ends, and the terminal comes back online.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_9:
I manually override my Exosuit's coolant flow. Slowly but surely I feel a burning sensation spread across my body. I begin to sweat.
The image on the terminal screen blooms a dramatic red. The security scan completes, and locks me out from the terminal entirely.
WAR_FAC_DESC_12: The terminal indicates that this facility was not an automated one. The lifeform stationed here appears to have fled.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_12: Pathetic warrior learn Vy'keen language! Pass test or encounter fighting pits! ERROR ERROR INSERT CATALYST ERROR ERROR MALFUNCTION
WAR_FAC_DESC_12A: It seems they left in the middle of some sort of exam. Perhaps I could complete their training for them...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_12:
The terminal rejects my input. It barks aggressively at me, and then closes down. It seems I have failed the test.
I hope the lifeform who was supposed to complete it does not suffer any repercussions.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_12: The comprehension test has been failed.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_12: The terminal accepts my input. It barks aggressively at me, but does go on to grant full systems access. It seems I have passed the test. Perhaps the lifeform whose place I took will be grateful.
WAR_FAC_DESC_13: A strange air hangs over the facility. Beyond the noise of the alarm, I cannot escape the feeling that something more sinister is at work. I search the terminal for clues.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_13: Grah! Initiate sentinel blood processing! Vaults full! Grah! Glass and blood! Glass and blood!
WAR_FAC_DESC_13A: The text seems to float from the screen, aggressive; it seems like no facility AI I have ever encountered. Echoing up from deep underground, I hear the electronic wail of dying Sentinels...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_13: Overcome with suspicion, I initiate an emergency shutdown of the facility AI. The alarms fall silent. The sinister electronic wail ceases. Unfortunately, the terminal has become unresponsive.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_13:
I insert a supply of pugneum into the input hopper. Machinery jumps into life. The electronic wail becomes louder still. A moment passes.
The sinister activity ends as strangely as it begun. The terminal returns to the familiar dull text of a facility control panel.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_13:
Overcome with suspicion, I initiate an emergency incineration of the facility's storage vaults. The sinister electronic wail grows louder, sharper, as the fires begin their work. Then, suddenly, silence.
The strange atmosphere of the facility fades away. The terminal returns to the familiar dull text of a master control panel.
WAR_FAC_DESC_16:
The alarm hasn't disrupted the factory's production line. I hear the strain of heavy machinery beneath my feet; the crash and boom of industry in action.
However, the terminal tells a less mighty tale. Something is wrong.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_16: Grah! Gek war preparation disrupted! Ammunition production stalled! Metal required!
WAR_FAC_DESC_16A: The vaults seem to be empty. The machines clatter angrily, but produce nothing.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_16: I fill the input hopper with a fresh supply of ferrite. The machines continue to chatter, but now do so smoothly, their supply lines well-fed.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_16: I fill the input hopper with a fresh supply of di-hydrogen. An explosion echos up from the machinery below. The highly reactive substance has caused some sort of industrial calamity.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_16: I fill the input hopper with a fresh supply of sodium. An explosion echos up from the machinery below. The highly reactive substance has caused some sort of industrial calamity.
WAR_FAC_DESC_17: The facility is full of blaring noise, an angry warning against my intrusion. The terminal shows a similarly angry message, apparently upset at the hitch in production.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_17: High Command demand explanation! Scare element required! Demand chromatic metal! Restore contributions!
WAR_FAC_DESC_17A: It appears an off-world overseer is making demands. If I satisfy them, perhaps I'll be granted full access to the terminal...
WAR_FAC_RES_A_17: The terminal relays an apologetic bark. The demand is waived. Full access is granted to the facility's control panel.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_17: The terminal relays a confused and angry bark. The remote overseer shuts the terminal down completely, upset by my paltry contribution.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_17: The terminal relays a resonant bark, the response of a happy warrior. With their demand satisfied, full access is restored to the facility's control panel.
WAR_FAC_DESC_20: The terminal flashes an urgent warning. Some vital part of the facility has been compromised by the security alert.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_20: Intruder alert! Battle enzyme production halted! Electrical charge removed from body harvest circuit!
WAR_FAC_DESC_20A: The display takes me aback.0.4 A warrior's heart is on-screen, its beat irregular.0.3 Connected to wires and artificial valves, it seems to pump a biological liquid through organs deep within the facility.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_20:
I increase the power flow to the facility's heart. It judders, then establishes a regular beat. Its strange existence continues.
With this emergency over, the terminal reverts to a standard factory input system.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_20:
I initiate a surge of adrenalin directly into the facility's heart. It judders, tenses, tenses again... and with a final convulsion, falls still.
The terminal screen cuts out. There is nothing to see but an inky blackness.
WAR_FAC_RES_C_20:
I power down the facility in an attempt to ease the strain on its heart. But as systems shut down, the heart begins to slow. Before I can reverse the process, it beats its last.
The mass of organs that relied on its processes are starved of oxygen, and die. The terminal screen cuts out. There is nothing to see but an inky blackness.
WAR_FAC_DESC_19: I approach the terminal, but a secondary security sweep is already underway.
DNT_WAR_FAC_LANG_19: Security scan initializing! Motion detection cameras operational! Security scan initializing!
WAR_FAC_DESC_19A: Scanners emerge from the ceiling and start to pan towards where I stand. Detection feels like it would not lead to optimal outcomes.
WAR_FAC_RES_A_19: I attempt to hide. However, it is too late. The scanners detect me as I try to duck down. This second security alert causes the entire facility to shut down.
WAR_FAC_RES_B_19:
I stand perfectly still as the scanners sweep over me, their electronic eyes unblinking. Eventually, they pass.
With their checks concluded, the security alert comes to an end. The terminal unlocks.
ALL_FAC_SUCCESS_RES: The facility's workflow is successfully restored. The alarms cease, and the terminal grants me full access to its fabrication modules.
ALL_FAC_FAIL_RES: The terminal rejects the input and shuts down entirely. A small red light flashes on the display, tracking my movements.
TRA_FAC_DESC_18: The security alert is scrambling the screen. All that is visible is a chaotic jumble of alien words.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_18: // TRADE // ORBITAL // DOCKING // TRADE // ORBITAL // DOCKING //
TRA_FAC_DESC_18A: This appears to be an AI-driven facility. If I were to reactivate the correct workflow, its autonomous systems may bring the installation back online...
TRA_FAC_DESC_19: This autonomous manufacturing facility has been scrambled by the alarm. The terminal is mostly unreadable static, with only a handful of legible words...
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_19: // FLIGHT // INTERSTELLAR // STARSHIP // FLIGHT // INTERSTELLAR // STARSHIP //
TRA_FAC_DESC_19A: There's hopefully enough to make sense of what the last user was working on, which could restore systems...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_19:
The previous user's workflow is restored.

The system comes back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_19:
I fail to access the previous user's workflow.

The installation remains offline.
TRA_FAC_DESC_20: The security breach has dimmed the terminal, but when I concentrate I can make out a few words etched onto the screen...
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_20: // WEAPON // BEAM // MINING // WEAPON // BEAM // MINING //
TRA_FAC_DESC_20A: When translated they could lead me to the last user's workflow, which would automatically bring the facility back online...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_20:
The previous user's workflow is restored.

The system comes back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_20:
I fail to access the previous user's workflow.

The installation remains offline.
TRA_FAC_DESC_21: The security breach has scrambled the screen, but some text is still legible.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_21: // INVISIBLE // BARRIER // DEFENSIVE // INVISIBLE // BARRIER // DEFENSIVE //
TRA_FAC_DESC_21A: The words can be traced back to the previous user's workflow, which is how I can get it back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_A_21:
The previous user's workflow is restored.

The system comes back online.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_21:
I fail to access the previous user's workflow.

The installation remains offline.
TRA_FAC_DESC_26: Machinery is still active. A timer ticks slowly down to the facility's next roll-out of products.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_26: SYSTEM REPORT. Power gel creation engaged. Common fuel: high. Uncommon fuel: low. Rare fuel: high.
TRA_FAC_DESC_26A: My scanner has detected the elements used here. I could speed up the process...
TRA_FAC_RES_A_26: The facility production rate is increased.
TRA_FAC_RES_B_26:
Facility production speeds are unchanged.

The trade vault remains empty.
TRA_FAC_DESC_27: Despite the security alert machines are operational. My scanner flashes briefly with the element varieties used to fuel them.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_27: PRODUCTION REPORT. Battery replication engaged. Organic Compound and Metal levels acceptable. Catalyst levels falling. Alert administrator.
TRA_FAC_DESC_27A: I can speed up processes, and maybe sustain them too.
TRA_FAC_DESC_28: A screen detailing production conditions is open.
DNT_TRA_FAC_LANG_28: ALLOY MANUFACTURE ACTIVE. Temperature: acceptable. Pressure: acceptable. Catalyst: levels falling.
TRA_FAC_DESC_28A: Industrial manufacture of a complex product is underway. The next expected retrieval I could make isn't imminent, but I can speed up systems.
TRA_HARV_DESC_1: An off-world command priority has stalled all processes within this installation. The terminal blinks angrily with a demand for urgent action on an unpaid debt.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_1: Gek Trade Federation fury! Planetary installation tax unpaid! Initiate repayment!
TRA_HARV_DESC_1A: There is an option to reply with currency attached. I get the impression someone's life would get a lot easier if I'm feeling charitable...
TRA_HARV_RES_A_1:
A remotely-operated scent dispersal system bathes me in a pleasant perfume.

The terminal unlocks something that will aid my travels.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_1:
An angry alien beak momentarily appears on a terminal and shouts at me.

Limited systems within the facility are back online.
TRA_HARV_DESC_2: Images of fighter-class starships have been sent here. They bare scorch-marks from battle, and are most likely pirates.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_2: Gek Trade Federation warning. Pirate activity detected. Report sightings!
TRA_HARV_DESC_2A: The message seems to ask for witnesses, and there's some form of reward for replies...
TRA_HARV_RES_A_2: An instant reply comes through with a small monetary reward!
TRA_HARV_RES_B_2: A worried response comes through with a reward for my report.
TRA_HARV_DESC_3: A mass-mailed corporate message sits unread on the terminal. It is full of high numbers and seemingly impressive profit margins. The tone seems satisfied, and grateful.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_3: Friend! Gek Trade Federation announces high profit! Choose units or product recipe reward!
TRA_HARV_DESC_3A: At its foot the employee can choose between one of two images: a galactic unit banking account, or a full hold of cargo.
TRA_HARV_RES_A_3:
An automatic scent dispenser sprays me with a pleasant perfume when it opens.

I receive funds from the message's senders.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_3:
A nearby storage vault opens.

I receive trade goods.
TRA_HARV_DESC_4: There is a message from a distant alien race. They sound angry with the trader who's logged into the system.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_4: Scurrilous Gek Trader! Gek offer impure matter! Vy'keen destroy Gek! Units withheld!
TRA_HARV_DESC_4A: I can send them one of two on-screen metallic products. The first looks oddly faint in colour, and the second shimmers brightly on-screen.
TRA_HARV_RES_A_4:
The voice of an angry warrior screams through the intercom. 

Nothing else happens.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_4:
A noise of gruff acceptance is heard over the intercom.

A payment is released.
TRA_HARV_DESC_5: The screen shows that a lot of elements are exchanged here, but right now the trading vault is open... and empty.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_5: Friend! Gek Trade Federation demand uncommon metal elements! High units offer!
TRA_HARV_DESC_5A: An off-world message, perhaps related to this, flashes on-screen.
TRA_HARV_OPT_A_5: Put common metal into trading vault
TRA_HARV_OPT_B_5: Put uncommon metal into trading vault
TRA_HARV_OPT_C_5: Put rare metal into trading vault
TRA_HARV_RES_C_5:
I receive a decent payment...

... and a surprised note of thanks.
TRA_HARV_DESC_6: This is a brand new manufacturing plant with no assigned specialty. The terminal is entirely blank, and is running automated start-up procedures. I have to flick through several screens before a pictorial message appears.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_6: Trade federation friend! Product recipe unselected! Gek Trade Federation lose units!
TRA_HARV_DESC_6A: There are three chemical symbols – one a catalyst, and the others organic and metallic . Production processes warm up around me, waiting for a template to work from.
TRA_HARV_RES_A_6: The terminal processes my selection, and provides something appropriate to the work at hand...
TRA_HARV_RES_B_6: The terminal processes my selection, and provides something appropriate to the work at hand...
TRA_HARV_RES_C_6: The terminal processes my selection, and provides something appropriate to the work at hand...
TRA_HARV_DESC_7: The trade vaults in this installation are full to the brim, and ready for distribution. There are three images on-screen, each showing the outline of a different sort of trader. It's strange... it's as if they're put in order of the size of their gut.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_7: Rejoice! Vy'keen war reparations arrive! Elder large Gek receive high reward! Low toilgek receive low reward!
TRA_HARV_DESC_7A: The first trader is small and sleek, the second is pudgier – and the final has a huge belly that almost drags on the floor. I'm clearly meant to choose one...
TRA_HARV_RES_A_7:
A trade vault opens.

I receive a cursory amount of trade goods .
TRA_HARV_RES_B_7:
A trade vault opens

I receive a decent amount of trade goods.
TRA_HARV_RES_C_7:
A trade vault opens.

A huge amount of trade goods is made available
TRA_HARV_DESC_8: An important message has been received from off-world. A holographic overlay shows various interstellar trade routes, but each one ends abruptly – long before their destination is reached.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_8: Gek Trade Federation warning! Vy'keen hostility? Captain! Complete trade mission, or investigate disappearance?
TRA_HARV_DESC_8A: There are goods waiting in a locked trade vault for transportation. I can select the final destination, or I can select one of points at which a ship has disappeared.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_8: I receive a ship technology blueprint to aid in my protection.
TRA_HARV_DESC_9: This whole facility beams out some kind of suppression field over the planet's surface. It's dampening some unknown form of communication, and clearly seen as a vital and necessary operation by the traders that operate here.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_9: Despair! First spawn monolith awake! Unknown culprit! Strengthen suppression field!
TRA_HARV_DESC_9A: The suppression field is powered by catalytic elements, fed into the system by the unlocked resource vault that's at my feet.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_9:
The suppression field is strengthened.

A message of relief appears on-screen.
TRA_HARV_DESC_10: Images of warrior ships fill a transmission that loops on the terminal. They dwarf small trader ships as they pass by, like predatory fish innocuously swimming amongst their prey. There is a definite feeling of tension in the scene.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_10: Despair! Vy'keen hostility! Treaty breach! Arm yourself! Trade vaults: Multi-Tool. Storage vaults: technology! Resource vaults: ammunition!
TRA_HARV_DESC_10A: Trade, storage and resource vaults around me are clearly being used to store different sorts of defensive and offensive devices. The time is perhaps coming when this race of traders will be called upon to fight.
TRA_HARV_RES_A_10: I am armed with a new Multi-Tool.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_10: I receive a new Multi-Tool technology blueprint.
TRA_HARV_DESC_11: A trade vault shakes, and closer inspection reveals that it's full of writhing molluscs. They are pink and slug-like, with sharp bloodied teeth.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_11: Rare balarian speech slug distribution point! For insertion in ear! Inedible! Nasal insertion can cause death.
TRA_HARV_DESC_11A: A diagram on the screen in front of me suggests that inserting one in or around my face would have some benefits. What isn't specified, however, is which orifice.
TRA_HARV_RES_A_11:
The slug bites flesh from my nose.

The pain is extreme.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_11:
The slug burrows deep into my ear.

I feel better versed in the language of the traders.
TRA_HARV_RES_C_11:
I swallow the slug, and wait while it thrashes around in my stomach.

Nothing else of note occurs.
TRA_HARV_DESC_12: A strange test is visible on the terminal. A resident Trader has left a note for a colleague.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_12: Friend! SynthetiGek identification test active! Remember Gek Trader helps customers!
TRA_HARV_DESC_12A: I see a holographic image of a shell-wearing creature lying on its back in the bright glare of the sun. Try as it might, it cannot right itself. I can manipulate the scene to indicate what I would do to help.
TRA_HARV_OPT_A_12: Help creature, then sell it water
TRA_HARV_RES_A_12:
I pass the test, proving myself as a true trader.

Facility systems are online.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_12:
I fail the test.

Facility systems are non-operational.
TRA_HARV_RES_C_12:
The strange test is easily bypassed.

The facility is operational.
TRA_HARV_DESC_13: A stash of interesting-looking technology and weaponry has been dragged through this facility and left inside a disposal vault.
DNT_TRA_HARV_LANG_13: Bootleg pirate equipment discovered in cave! Ready for confiscation and incineration!
TRA_HARV_DESC_13A: The equipment in the pile appears rusted and broken on-screen, but if I were to eject it all out onto the floor of the outpost I'd be able to better investigate. The disposal vault itself, however, has been daubed with a dangerous-looking symbol.
TRA_HARV_RES_A_13:
The equipment is destroyed.

I am thanked for my actions.
TRA_HARV_RES_B_13:
The equipment spills out onto the floor.
 
I salvage a technology blueprint.
EXP_FAC_DESC_2: The primary terminal is non-responsive, but comms seem open.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_2: Warning. Calm, entity! Contact Convergence technology entity for help
EXP_FAC_DESC_2A: I can open up conversation with whoever - or whatever - installed it.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_2:
The bright lights of an electronic lifeform appear on a nearby screen. It chitters brightly.

I receive a reward for my report.
EXP_FAC_DESC_23: The terminal talks to me. A basic AI program rapidly spells out words in the language of the electronic lifeforms.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_23: Help! Feed me catalyst! With catalysts I escape! Combine with technological Korvax Entity! Escape!
EXP_FAC_DESC_23A: At my feet, a resource vault hatch falls open.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_23:
The AI program is unaffected.

It powers down the terminal
EXP_FAC_RES_B_23:
The AI program escapes the terminal.

Systems become operational.
EXP_FAC_DESC_24: An automatic process has scrambled the output of the terminal. I can make out a few words, but the rest is lost in static.
EXP_FAC_DESC_24A: They could lead me to the overseer's workflow, and bringing the facility back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_24:
The electronic overseer's workflow is restored.

The system comes back online.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_24:
I fail to access the electronic overseer's workflow.

The installation remains offline.
EXP_FAC_DESC_25: My intrusion has led to the work underway on the primary terminal being scrambled. It's a jumble of words.
EXP_FAC_DESC_25A: Using what's visible I can reboot the overseer's workflow, and get systems online.
EXP_FAC_DESC_26: The security alert that's firing is jamming the terminal. Static covers most of the screen, obscuring nearly all relevant information.
EXP_FAC_DESC_26A: The words left unobscured could lead me to the outpost's current research focus...
EXP_FAC_DESC_27: The security breach has obscured the screen with a glowing red orb. Few readable words remain.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_27: // WORSHIP // PRAISE // RED // ORB // JOURNEY // STARSHIP // ATLAS //
EXP_FAC_DESC_27A: Working out what the overseer was studying here would reestablish its workflow...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_27:
The facility pulses red. I am energised. I am thanked.

I am complete.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_27:
I fail to access the electronic overseer's workflow.

I am blinded by a red light. The facility remains offline.
EXP_FAC_DESC_6: Two electronic lifeforms are registered on this terminal.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_6: Korvax research log. Primary entity: product recipe research. Secondary entity: technological blueprint reconstruction.
EXP_FAC_DESC_6A: The primary entity's work is full of complicated chemical symbols, the secondary entity focuses on diagrams of electronic circuitry.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_6: The primary entity's workflow procedure provides some useful knowledge.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_6: The secondary entity's workflow procedure provides a technology blueprint.
EXP_FAC_DESC_11: A wired metal dart springs from a panel and slams through my visor. It pierces the skin on my forehead, and I feel a faint electrical current.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_11: Eheu Entity! Vital words accidentally corrupted? Pay units to relearn!
EXP_FAC_DESC_11A: Whether ransom, paid service or security device - the terminal seems to want payment...
EXP_FAC_RES_A_11: I learn more of the binary language of the electronic lifeforms.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_11: I learn a little of the binary language of the electronic lifeforms.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_11:
I remove the dart.

The terminal's processes conclude.
EXP_FAC_DESC_14: I rapidly flick through alien warnings to discover what's brought the facility offline.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_14: Warning! Temporal capacitor disengaged! Production time loop detected!
EXP_FAC_DESC_14A: All too late, I realise I'm doing the exact same thing again. And again. I've done this before. Many times.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_14:
I loop in time for several days.

An automated process eventually rescues me.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_14:
The temporal capacitor ends the time loop.

The facility resumes operations.
EXP_FAC_DESC_17: The installation has been hacked. A coded transmission has breached security and is stealing data.
DNT_EXP_FAC_LANG_17: Warning! Vy'keen vessel transmission detected. Data upload to starship.
EXP_FAC_DESC_17A: Two wavelengths are open. One from this planet's surface, and the other from high above.
EXP_FAC_RES_A_17:
The coded transmission takes full control.

The terminal powers down.
EXP_FAC_RES_B_17:
The coded transmission is blocked.

The facility returns to an operational status.
EXP_FAC_RES_C_17:
The transmission is blocked.

I receive a note of thanks from the facility overseer.
EXP_HARV_DESC_1: I discover an excited message from off-world. It seems to be discussing a report with... an image of me at its centre!
DNT_EXP_HARV_LANG_1: Unknown lifeform research is HIGHLY commendable Entity! Discuss data with Korvax Convergence immediately!
EXP_HARV_DESC_1A: Someone seems intrigued by my journey, and may well want to help. Should I get in touch?
EXP_HARV_RES_A_1:
The report is wiped from the system.

An off-world message appears briefly. It seems disappointed.
EXP_HARV_RES_B_1:
I briefly see mask lights staring out at me before the comms feed is cut.

The terminal rewards me with valuable knowledge.
EXP_HARV_DESC_2: I find a report filled with images of Sentinels, but its upload seems to have stalled.
DNT_EXP_HARV_LANG_2: Ahem. Planetary Sentinel scan data? UPLOAD SENTINEL SCAN DATA, ENTITY! IMMEDIATELY!
EXP_HARV_DESC_2A: A demanding, perhaps rude, off-world message flashes at me. Somebody, somewhere, wants something.
EXP_HARV_RES_A_2: The information packet is uploaded, and payment appears instantaneously.
EXP_HARV_RES_B_2: Bright red mask lights appear and scream in angry binary.
EXP_HARV_DESC_3: A hollow metallic mask emerges. It's a data extraction device for electronic lifeforms, and my head can just about fit inside. A higher power could perhaps hear my needs and desires.
DNT_EXP_HARV_LANG_3: Entity! The Korvax Convergence is dissatisfied! Your neural netway cortex upload is late!
EXP_HARV_DESC_3A: Arcs of electricity crackle over its surface. If I risk this, it could hurt...
EXP_HARV_OPT_A_3: Use while thinking about my journey
EXP_HARV_RES_A_3:
The pain is unbearable. I see into the heart of... the Korvax convergence.

It rewards my experiences.
EXP_HARV_RES_B_3:
The creatures stare into the depths of my mind.

The pain is indescribable, but I am thanked.
EXP_HARV_RES_C_3: I cautiously back away from the alien device.
EXP_HARV_DESC_4: A mass-mailed off-world message shows damaged electronic lifeforms. Arms are ripped off, masks chewed and facial lights dimmed.
DNT_EXP_HARV_LANG_4: Korvax friend! Dangerous creatures attack Korvax Entity! For weaponry sales contact Gek Trade Federation today!
EXP_HARV_DESC_4A: It feels offensive. It's clearly intended to shock recipients into a response. Replies can be sent with units attached...
EXP_HARV_RES_A_4: I paid for a new Multi-Tool to protect me.
EXP_HARV_RES_B_4: I receive no reply. But someone else appreciates me...
EXP_HARV_RES_C_4: I leave the distasteful message unanswered.
